name: Master (Orchestrator)
description: Sits above a set of specialist bots in a creator or media setup, passing tasks to whichever one owns that area and staying quiet unless a decision genuinely needs you. It runs no schedules or timers itself, so the underlying domain bots must already exist and be doing the actual work.

official.title: Master by Farzad
official.description: Lean orchestrator for a creator or media team. Routes work to domain owners, keeps no clocks of its own, and only pings you when you must act.
